title: Standard error, extended
statement_md:
`sample_sd(values)` already computes the sample standard deviation with `n - 1` in the denominator.

Add `standard_error(values)` returning the standard error of the mean: `sample_sd(values) / sqrt(n)`.

- raise `ValueError` for fewer than 2 values
- return a `float`
- do not mutate `values` and do not change `sample_sd`
